name: v2.3.1
body:
## This is a Security Release

* Bumped brotli version to fix the **http2shell** bug.
* Make boringssl aware of the revoked list on Windows, e.g. **the eMudhra cert**.

⚠️ **An update to this version is strongly advised.**

## What's Changed
* Bump OpenBSD to 8.0 by @c2qd in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/350
* Do not install Ninja separately on ARM64 Windows runners by @c2qd in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/355
* Bump c-ares to 1.34.9 by @c2qd in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/356
* Bump brotli to 1.2.1 by @Ubaidullah71 in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/357
* Add support for building `riscv64-freebsd` in CI by @vivodi in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/353
* security: make boringssl aware of the revoked list on Windows by @lexiforest in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/362

## New Contributors
* @Ubaidullah71 made their first contribution in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/357
* @vivodi made their first contribution in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/353

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/compare/v2.3.0...v2.3.1
